articles.summary: Picking a new James Bond has long followed a tried-and-tested formula: Don’t go too famous. The secret agent has nearly always been played by an up-and-coming, well-regarded talent who looks good in a tux. So for years, as the debate has dragged on over who would replace Daniel Craig in the role, dozens of names along those lines have bubbled up; these most recently included Jack Lowden, Callum Turner, and Josh O’Connor. Some possible candidates aged out of the role while waiting for it to open up, in the same way that potential popes find themselves hitting retirement age before their chance at the papacy arrives. stories.summary: French protests driven by frustration over the cost of living and public services resume today, with economists offering a bleak prognosis for one of Europe’s biggest economies. The French government is grappling with sky-high debt, a worrying deficit, and slow growth , while public anger has propelled a far-right party into the driver’s seat for 2027 presidential elections.
